Card Q&A.q: When this Digimon would be deleted, if neither [SkullKnightmon] or [DeadlyAxemon] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, can I still return 1 level 4 or lower black Digimon card from this Digimon's digivolution cards to my hand when activating this card's [All Turns]?

Effect: [On Play] ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, if DigiXrosing with 2 cards, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with a play cost of 5 or less.

[All Turns] When this Digimon would be deleted, by returning 1 level 4 or lower black Digimon card from this Digimon's digivolution cards to its owner's hand, you may play 1 [SkullKnightmon] or [DeadlyAxemon] from this Digimon's digivolution cards without paying its play cost.
Special Play Condition: DigiXros -2: [SkullKnightmon] × [DeadlyAxemon] When you would play this card, you may place specified cards from your hand/battle area under it. Each placed card reduces the play cost.
